structure_policy_rationale: 快影原始图标已经是高度抽象的几何符号（摄像机），符合主题中‘保留清晰几何符号’的条件。参考快手（Kuaishou）的处理方式，应保留其核心的C形机身和右侧镜头块的空间布局，仅将平滑的矢量线条转化为粗犷的手绘色块，不做语义重构。
preserve: 左侧包围式的C形机身轮廓
右侧悬浮的两个矩形/梯形块（镜头/信号）
must_preserve: 粗黑色的不规则手绘描边
右侧两个独立几何块的相对位置关系
recompose_allowed: 将原本的粉橙渐变色替换为砖红、深蓝或奶黄的纯色填充
将平滑的圆角调整为略带抖动的手工圆弧
调整内部色块的分割比例以适应手绘风格
restyle: 去除所有立体光影、高光和渐变
应用干性绘画介质（蜡笔/马克笔）质感
边缘处理为毛糙、不规则的手绘痕迹
forbid: 保留原本的粉橙渐变色
使用细线条或无描边设计
添加立体光影或高光效果
改变摄像机的基本朝向
使用绿色、紫色等非主题色系
写实相机照片或复杂细节
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle icon of a video camera on pure black background. Shape: thick C-shaped body opening right, with two separate geometric blocks floating on the right as lens. Colors: solid high-saturation brick red, deep blue, or creamy yellow flat fills, NO gradients. Style: heavy rough uneven black marker outlines, crayon texture, naive and clumsy aesthetic. Centered composition.
color_application: Map original warm gradient to theme's limited palette: use Brick Red for the main C-body, Deep Blue or Creamy Yellow for the right-side lens blocks. Ensure high saturation and flat filling.
stroke_application: Apply heavy, rough, uneven black marker-style outlines to all shapes. Edges must look hand-drawn with slight jitter, not smooth vector lines.
composition_application: Center the simplified camera symbol. Maintain the horizontal layout (C-body left, lens blocks right). Subject occupies ~60% of canvas against pure black background.
identity_application: Preserve the topological structure of the 'C' frame and the two detached right-side blocks to maintain the 'camera/recording' semantic. Do not merge them into a single solid shape.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, rough black hand-drawn strokes
Colors must be from the restricted palette (Red/Blue/Yellow)
No gradients, shadows, or lighting effects
negative_constraints: No realistic camera details or photorealism
No thin or clean vector lines
No generic play buttons or film reels
